utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Wait, a repair drive? Is that for the community center? I feel like I'm always the last to know around here.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, it's actually been moved to Sunday at the community center now! I was just about to update everyone about the change.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sunday? Huh, I guess I really am out of the loop—thanks for letting me know!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Vik! I've been telling everyone about the repair drive this Saturday—sounds like we'll have a great turnout!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I've been spreading the word too! Jules and Eli are really pumped, and we're all meeting at the park at 10 AM to fix those benches.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Awesome, 10 AM at the park – I'll be there bright and early to help with those benches!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Gus, sorry I'm late—did I miss anything about the repair drive setup?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries, Dane! I was just saying we got plenty of wrenches and screwdrivers ready. Rey's gonna use his garage for small appliance repairs too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, sounds like we're in good shape. I'll grab a few extra paintbrushes from my shed just in case.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It's Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sunday at the community center? Right, that’s when we fix… something. Was it the toaster oven or the computer?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Bring small appliances and batteries. That's all.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: A repair drive? Who told you that? I haven't said anything about it yet.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Mina mentioned it to me earlier – she asked if it was for the community center computer.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Mina? How does she know about that? I barely mentioned it to anyone.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Just making sure everyone's on the same page for next Saturday's repair drive—I'll have the flyers ready by tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, Faye! I'll double-check our supply list tonight to make sure we're not missing anything critical like nails or tape.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Cleo! I'll bring extra flyers to the community center tomorrow so we can start spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, you're working on that repair drive? Is it for the community center computer?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, exactly! They're setting up a fix-it station in the parking lot, and I heard they have a spot for electronics repairs.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Wait, the parking lot? I thought it was moved to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Hi Bo, just so you know, the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, Sunday works better for me anyway. I can still help with the fences—just let me know if you need me to bring anything.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, that's a relief! Could you bring any spare screws or nails you have? I want to make sure we have enough fasteners.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Ira, have you heard about the repair drive? We could use an extra pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, I've heard bits and pieces. Sounds like we're fixing up the community center computer? I can probably lend a hand if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That'd be great, Ira! Yeah, it's to fix up some old computers for the community center. I'm rounding up tools and volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Eli, I just heard the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday on the porch.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Ah, is that so? Well, I suppose we'll just have to adjust. Sunday at the community center it is then – I'll make a note of it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: So, should we still sort through the tools on Sunday morning instead?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, so it's not either of those? What exactly is it then?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It's for the community center computer. We're trying to get it fixed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, the computer! I knew it was something about fixing... I just keep confusing it with the food events.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Rosa! Did you hear? They moved the repair drive to Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, I just updated the flyers this morning to avoid any confusion—Sunday at the community center, 10am sharp!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, glad that's sorted. I also heard from Cleo that we're good on screwdrivers, so we should be all set!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I'm just tallying up what we've got—Eli, you remembered the duct tape, right? That stuff always runs out first.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I heard Eli's got the duct tape, and Jules is excited about the repair drive next Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh good, so we're set on duct tape then. Next Saturday, right—I'll double-check the tool inventory to make sure we have enough wrenches and screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, next Saturday? I thought we were doing it this weekend. Did I miss something?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I think Faye mentioned last week that it got moved to next Saturday. I heard it from Mrs. Gable down the street.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Ah, right—the school bake sale. I remember now. I must've spaced on that detail.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Saturday? Yeah, I'm in for the fences. Got my tools ready.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It's actually Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, Sunday? Right, must've mixed it up. Still good for the fences though.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Oh, so Vik's been spreading the word already! I'd love to lend a hand with tools or whatever you need this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Hold on, Sam — the date's changed. The drive is now Sunday at the community center, not Saturday on the porch. Make sure you spread that around.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Got it, Sunday at the community center. I'll let the others know about the change.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Hana! I just ran into Jules, who offered to help spread the word about the repair drive. It's really coming together.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Wait, Ira—does Jules know the repair drive is a USB drive for fixing the computer, not a community event? I want to make sure she has the right info.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, good catch, Hana! I'll make sure Jules knows it's a USB drive—can you believe the mix-up?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, we're moving it to next Saturday so it doesn't conflict with the school bake sale.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Wait, I thought it moved to Sunday at the community center. Are you sure about Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, I'm sure—we decided next Saturday morning at the community center parking lot, since the bake sale is this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Opal, sorry I'm late—did I miss anything important about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Just the location—it's at the community center parking lot, and we're collecting screws and nails if you have any.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it, community center parking lot for screws and nails. I'll bring what I can.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Kira, I've got some spare wrenches and screwdrivers if you need 'em for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: A repair drive? Who told you that? I haven't said anything about it yet.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Oh, sorry—I must've jumped the gun. I heard from Tess that there might be one at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Jules, you're going to be at the repair drive this Saturday, right? We're fixing up the community center and could use your help!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, I'll be there! I've already been telling everyone about it. Can't wait to help fix up the community center.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Awesome, Jules! With you on board, we're going to get a lot done. See you Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh Tess, I'm so glad you're here! I need to let you know the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday on the porch.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Mara, you're a lifesaver! I just told Pia about the Saturday plan—I better catch her before she heads over to the wrong spot.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, good thinking! Pia would have been so confused showing up at the porch. I'll help you spread the word to anyone else who might have missed the change.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? I think I heard something about that... could you remind me what we're fixing again?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Sure! It's about mending small household items—tools, chairs, that sort of thing—and we've moved it to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sunday, right? I'll try to remember that... maybe I can bring my wobbly table.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Uli, I heard the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center. Just wanted to make sure you knew.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, Sunday? I thought it was Saturday. I'll have to adjust my schedule. Thanks for letting me know.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: No problem, glad I caught you. I've got some tools in my garage if you need anything for it.
